tools.name: get_orderflow_snapshot
tools.description: Returns a compact orderflow reading for one Hyperliquid perpetual market, computed by Buildix from recent fills, the order book and market context: direction of recent buy and sell flow (CVD), order book imbalance (OBI) and flow toxicity (VPIN) as categories, funding rate and open interest. Use it when the user asks about buying or selling pressure, order book balance, flow toxicity, funding or open interest for one coin or HIP-3 market.

symbol.description: Market ticker such as "BTC", "ETH", "SOL" or "kPEPE" (case-insensitive; "PEPE" also works), or a HIP-3 market as "dex:COIN" such as "xyz:NVDA".

detail.description: "brief" (default) returns labels and key numbers. "full" adds the underlying values, data age and method notes.

tools.name: get_liquidation_levels
tools.description: Returns the main liquidation levels above and below the current price for one Hyperliquid perpetual market, estimated from the whole open interest with an assumed leverage mix: price, distance and size of each cluster, and in detail "full" a wider range and the amount liquidated on moves of 5, 10 and 15%. A model, not a record of positions. Use it when the user asks where liquidations sit around the price or how much could be liquidated on a move of a given size.

symbol.description: Market ticker such as "BTC", "ETH", "SOL" or "kPEPE" (case-insensitive; "PEPE" also works), or a HIP-3 market as "dex:COIN" such as "xyz:NVDA".

detail.description: "brief" (default) returns labels and key numbers. "full" adds the underlying values, data age and method notes.

tools.name: get_whale_positioning
tools.description: Returns the aggregated long versus short positioning of the large Hyperliquid accounts Buildix tracks for one market: long and short notional, the number of accounts on each side and the resulting bias. No account addresses are returned. Use it when the user asks whether whales or large traders are long or short a coin.

symbol.description: Market ticker such as "BTC", "ETH", "SOL" or "kPEPE" (case-insensitive; "PEPE" also works), or a HIP-3 market as "dex:COIN" such as "xyz:NVDA".

detail.description: "brief" (default) returns labels and key numbers. "full" adds the underlying values, data age and method notes.

tools.name: get_funding_rates
tools.description: Returns Hyperliquid perpetual funding rates ranked from highest to most negative, annualized, with a market-wide summary (median, open-interest-weighted average, count of positive and negative markets). Markets under $1M of open interest are left out of the rankings. Use it when the user asks which markets pay the highest or most negative funding, or how funding looks across Hyperliquid.

detail.description: "brief" (default) returns labels and key numbers. "full" adds the underlying values, data age and method notes.

tools.name: get_market_screener
tools.description: Returns a snapshot of the Hyperliquid perpetual market: number of markets, total open interest and 24h volume, breadth, open-interest-weighted funding, the top markets by 24h volume, price change, open interest or funding, and the largest 24h gainers and losers. Use it for market overviews, top movers or the most active markets.

detail.description: "brief" (default) returns labels and key numbers. "full" adds the underlying values, data age and method notes.

sort_by.description: Column for the top list: "volume" (default, 24h volume), "change" (absolute 24h price change), "open_interest" or "funding" (absolute rate).

tools.name: get_top_traders
tools.description: Returns the top 10 of the Buildix Top Traders ranking of large Hyperliquid accounts: address, label, Trader Score, confidence, style badge and, once the ranking exists, the official rank, Verified flag, Follow Score, follower PnL over 30 days and rank 24 hours ago. The Follow Score is what a copier would have kept; score_version says how: v3 assumes a copy 10 minutes late, v4 simulates a fixed 2% stop, fees and slippage on a sampled price path. Wallets with a losing lifetime record, market makers and hedged books are not ranked. Position changes under $50,000 are not seen. Use it to pick Hyperliquid wallets to study before copy trading. Data only: Buildix does not execute trades.

detail.description: "brief" (default) returns labels and key numbers. "full" adds the underlying values, data age and method notes.
